moves.comment: Take space in the centre and open the diagonals of your queen and f1 bishop. The reply decides which part of your White repertoire to follow.

children.comment: Capture the pawn that challenges your centre. This is not a promise of an extra pawn: develop promptly after Black recaptures or attacks the pawn.
Develop the knight with an attack on the queen on d5. Gain time for development rather than chasing the queen with repeated pawn moves.
